extremerrage wrote:

yes my entry was after the cap , why ? because on the 15 m chart
stops are triggered , then on the 5 m there is a cap and the last candle
 is a bearish engulfing , means sellers are in control, red call this
pattern a whipsaw engulfing and thats the best confirmation because
 you already know there game !! ps :without ignoring the compression before the cap also

Thanks a lot for the reply :). I've always been wondering what
Whipsaw engulfing meant, I've seen RED mentioning about that setup in
his charts from the Price is everything PDF.

So a whipsaw engulfing is essentially a Fakeout with a Engulfing candle?
 or am i wrong? But how would we know that it was a fakeout? Because
when the price starts to come down i would start to think that the
previous high which was broken would act as a swap level facilitating
the price to continue up with the existing trend? I believe I'm putting
my query right.

Thank you.

R.B.N.J

author: extremerrage
text:
whipsaw engulfing is a cluster where supply and demand are balanced ,
when Cluster resolves north it becomes demand , and when Cluster is
engulfed south by big sellers is supply ,, simply it is where big
players are stacking there orders .thats how i understand it also :)
